title: The Third Son of a Knight Baron Family’s True Ambition
description: The protagonist is reborn as the third son of a knight baron family, retaining memories of his past life. Though he possesses no special supernatural abilities, the innate 'Gift' he was born with allows him to enroll in the royal capital's magic academy. While his flashy fiancée runs wild in aristocratic society, he focuses solely on making the most of the academy's environment to hone himself for the sake of his family. This is because he seeks a means for the people who gave him a love he never experienced in his previous life to live in peace. He is a child of the frontier, and of a knight baron family...
author: Ryūsōwan
